expert_results.expert_description: Q-Insight distortion expert for artifact decisions. It inspects visible image degradation and outputs a structured distortion class plus severity, intended to help planner route artifact checks and help reflector interpret whether artifact evidence is meaningful.
expert_results.output_meaning: Returns a structured distortion judgment for artifact analysis. distortion_class is one of noise/compression/blur/darken/null. severity is one of slight/moderate/obvious/serious/catastrophic/null. In system aggregation, null/null means no targeted distortion detected; non-null distortion_class means the model found a likely visible distortion relevant to artifact scoring.
